title: fix(cli): os migrate finds the SQL driver on a wasm-sqlite:// database, so the ownership ceremony and os migrate plan run on it
body:
Fixes #23648
Clause-②: no

**On PR #23647.** This card builds on PR #23647 (#23558), whose `dialectOfDriver` resolves the wasm driver to `sqlite` once it is found. As ruled, this branch first merged that PR's head `107a7a923c` as one merge commit, without rewriting it. PR #23647 has since landed on `main` (`c2bb302c8`, from that same head). This branch then merged `main` twice (`286eb9ef3`, then `1ced0f82b`), and its head is `0e446f4bf`. So the file diff against `main` is this card's alone: 5 files. The commit list still shows PR #23647's four commits, because `main` holds them as one squash commit.

## What changed

- `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.ts`: `SQL_DRIVER_SERVICES` lists `driver.com.objectstack.driver.sqlite-wasm`, the key a `wasm-sqlite://` boot was measured to register. It is one more name in a list, not a `driver.*` pattern. A driver without the schema-migration seam (`detectManagedDrift` and `applyMigrationEntries`) is still not found under any key. A SQL driver under a key the list does not name is still not found either.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/unmanaged-tables.ts`: `os migrate plan`'s unmanaged-table sweep resolves the dialect through `dialectOfDriver` (`dialectName` first), not from `config.client` as a string only. This is folded in because the change above makes it reachable. With only the list fix, every `wasm-sqlite://` plan reported the section `unreadable` ("the connected dialect (unnamed client) is not one this sweep enumerates tables on"), since this driver's client is a knex client class. PR #23647's Acceptance notes recorded this reader as having "no reach today". This PR is what gives it reach.
- Two new test files and one changeset (`@objectstack/cli` patch). No new export.

## Premise check

Read on `origin/main` `7cb33cfef` with PR #23647 merged in (`60ae7a6a8`).

- **H1, the service key: measured.** I booted `bootSchemaStack` on `wasm-sqlite://FILE` and listed every `driver.*` service. There is exactly one: `driver.com.objectstack.driver.sqlite-wasm`, an `_SqliteWasmDriver` with `dialectName: 'sqlite'` and a class-valued `config.client`. `stack.driver` was `null` and `dbLabel` was `unknown`. `DefaultDatasourcePlugin` registers the default driver as `driver.` followed by the driver's `name`.
- **H2, the readers.**
  - `SQL_DRIVER_SERVICES` is read by `findSqlDriverVia`, which `findSqlDriver` and `findSqlDriverForKernel` call.
  - `findSqlDriver` is called by `bootSchemaStack`, the boot behind 19 `os migrate` / `os storage` / `os secret` commands.
  - `findSqlDriverForKernel` is called by `os serve`'s boot-time migration gate when an artifact is pinned with `OS_ARTIFACT_URL`.
  - `DeferSchemaDdlPlugin.init` iterates the list too. It also arms every `driver.*` service, so the wasm driver was already held to a dry run.
  - `findTelemetryDriver` uses its own list (`driver.telemetry`) and is unchanged.
  - `os migrate plan` meets the same lookup: it was measured (below) and is folded in.
- **H3, the seam: measured.** On the booted driver, `detectManagedDrift`, `applyMigrationEntries`, `setDeferredDdl` and `execute` are functions, and `raw` is undefined. `execute` is the seam `resolvePlannedDriverExec` takes. `SqliteWasmDriver` extends `SqlDriver`.
- **H4, the dialect: measured.** With PR #23647 merged in, the ceremony's plan and apply both run on a `wasm-sqlite://` database. The apply step is handed `dialect: 'sqlite'` (unit pin). The plan's first statement is the SQLite catalog read.

## Before and after, at the doors

Fixture: a project with a compiled artifact that declares no object, plus `OS_AUTH_SECRET`. The database was created on `wasm-sqlite://` by `os migrate apply`, and each door ran on its own copy. "Before" is the same copy run with `schema-migrate.ts` and `unmanaged-tables.ts` restored from `60ae7a6a8`. The restore was trap-guarded, and afterwards each blob equalled HEAD and `git diff HEAD` was empty. "After" was measured at `030a6d826` (the list fix) for the ceremony's `--apply` and for `os migrate apply` on a fresh file, and at `525ecbe67` (with the sweep fix) for the rest. Every command was run through `bin/run-dev.js` with `--json`.

| door | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `os migrate organization-ownership` (plan) | exit 1, `plan_refused` / `driver-unsupported` | exit 0, plan written (`client: null`) |
| `… --apply --backup-taken --plan-file` | exit 1, `apply_refused` / `driver-unsupported` | exit 0, all nine steps `done`, the `adr-0131-organization-ownership` ledger row persisted in the file |
| `os migrate plan` | exit 0, `{"error":"no_sql_driver","changes":[]}` | exit 0, a plan; `unmanagedTables.status: read`, 71 physical tables (the list fix alone: `unreadable`, "unnamed client") |
| `os migrate apply` (fresh file) | exit 0, `{"error":"no_sql_driver"}`, nothing created | exit 0, 71 tables created and persisted in the file |
| `os migrate multi-value-columns` | exit 0, `no_sql_driver` | exit 0, `targets: []` (no conversion applies on SQLite) |
| `os migrate unmapped-columns --object sys_user` | exit 0, `no_sql_driver` | exit 0, `columns: []` |
| `duplicates`, `account-issuer`, `meta --stored`, `audit-metadata-bodies`, `comment-reactions`, `security-catalog-overlays`, `os storage orphans` | exit 0, `database: unknown` | exit 0, the same counts, `database` names the file |
| `recorded-by`, `resume`, `os secret rewrap`, `os secret orphans` | exit 0 | exit 0, the same answer (no driver read) |
| `value-shapes`, `files-to-references`, `summary-nulls` | exit 1, "No app objects are loaded" | the same: the fixture declares no object, so `files-to-references`' driver read (`planMediaColumnMove`) was not reached. NOT MEASURED. |
| `os serve` with `OS_ARTIFACT_URL=file://…` declaring `storage.notNull` on a nullable column | booted ("Server is ready"); the destructive drift was only warned | refused to boot: "Refusing to boot — 1 destructive schema change(s) required", naming the column |

The `os serve` row is the one behaviour change outside `os migrate`. Its gate's own comment says "no SQL driver" is that gate's everything-is-fine answer. On a `wasm-sqlite://` database the gate now runs as it does on every other SQL database. It was measured on its own fixture, seeded through `file:` and served through `wasm-sqlite://`, at `a4b58bf18`. The before side had the new key removed through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, and afterwards the blob equalled HEAD.

## Tests

- `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.sql-driver-lookup.test.ts` (new, `unit` tier, 12 tests):
  - The lookup finds the wasm driver under its key.
  - It still finds the three previously listed keys.
  - Control: a SQL-shaped driver under an unlisted key (`driver.com.example.driver.sql-compatible`, `driver.telemetry`, `driver.default`) stays unfound.
  - Control: a driver without the schema-migration seam stays unfound under the memory, MongoDB and wasm keys.
  - At the command, with `bootSchemaStack` replaced by a stack whose driver is the real lookup's answer: both ceremony arms refuse `driver-unsupported` on three refused shapes, with exit 1, no statement run, no plan file and the apply step never called. Both arms proceed on the wasm driver, and the apply step is handed `dialect: 'sqlite'`.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/sqlite-wasm.integration.test.ts` (new, `integration` tier, 3 tests): the real boots on one `wasm-sqlite://` file, through each command's `run()`.
  - `os migrate apply` creates the schema in the file (`sys_migration` among it, read back past the driver).
  - `os migrate plan` plans it, with the unmanaged-table sweep `read` and its count equal to the file's tables.
  - The ceremony plans it, then applies the reviewed plan: every step `done`, and the ledger row in the file.

Runs, all under the shared verify lock:

- **Final head `0e446f4bf`.**
  - `unit` project, by path: the new lookup file, `unmanaged-tables.test.ts`, and the two published-subpath pins. 4 files, 82 tests passed.
  - `integration` project, by path: the new file, `unmanaged-tables`, `organization-ownership-plan`, `schema-migrate`, and the four `plan.*` integration suites. 8 files, 33 tests passed. This layer was run locally because the diff adds an integration-tier file and changes the sweep those suites read.
- **`1eb7378cd`** (the merge of `286eb9ef3`). The cli code is the same as the final head; the later merge brought only `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**`.
  - The whole `unit` layer: 290 of 292 files and 4325 tests passed. The 2 failed files (`test/published-subpath-console.pin.test.ts`, `test/published-subpath-hook-body.pin.test.ts`) refused because `packages/cli` was not built ("./dist/index.js is absent"). That is a missing prerequisite, not a measurement. Both passed on the final head once the cli was built (above).
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` and `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.

## Ablation

These are one-off proofs, run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode with an `EXIT INT TERM` restore trap, at `a4b58bf18`. No `dist/` is involved: the subjects are cli `src` files, imported relatively, and metadata-core is aliased to `src` in the cli vitest config.

- **The new key dropped from `SQL_DRIVER_SERVICES`.** On disk, anchor 1 went to 0 and blob `b1fcdf46db73` became `a46e1ec56ca9`.
  - Unit: 3 red, 9 green. The three wasm positives went red; every control and the no-regression case stayed green.
  - Integration: 3 red, 0 green (`no_sql_driver`, and the ceremony's exit 1).
  - Restored: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **The sweep returned to reading `config.client` as a string only.** On disk, anchor 1 went to 0 and the marker went to 1. Blob `c647aec174bc` became `a2097e2e9892`.
  - Integration: 1 red, 2 green. The `os migrate plan` case went red (`unreadable`).
  - Restored: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Gates

Local, on `0e446f4bf`:

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 64 commands from merge base `1ced0f82b`, over the 5 changed paths. All 64 were run in sequence, each exit code captured before any pipe: **64 of 64 exit 0**.
- `--ran`: "64 derived, 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", exit 0.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage` and `check:i18n-walk-parity` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET) on the first pass, at `1eb7378cd`. So did `check:type-check-debt`, whose closure build queued past its lock budget. All five exited 0 at `0e446f4bf`, after a turbo build of the closures they name.
- The ratchet families in this set, `check:type-check-coverage` and `check:type-check-debt`: exit 0.
- Not named by the derivation: `eslint --no-inline-config packages/cli` exited 0 with no output, and a JSON-format run over the four changed `.ts` files reported 0 errors and 0 warnings in each. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- Control-byte self-scan of the 5 changed files: no hit.

## Acceptance notes

- **`os serve` keeps a second list of driver service names** (`describeRegisteredDriver` in `serve.ts`), and it also omits `sqlite-wasm`. Serve reads it only to label the banner when it resolved no driver label itself. It was not measured and is not changed here. Carrier: none.
- **`os migrate duplicates` passes `String(config.client)` as its `client`.** For this driver that string is the client class's source text. It is read only to pick MySQL backtick quoting, so the SQLite quoting stays right. It is not echoed into the report: measured, the report on the wasm database matched the one before, apart from the database name, and no output carried the class text. Carrier: none.
- **A stale header comment.** `organization-ownership.dialect.test.ts` (PR #23647's file, now on `main`) says the command's boot "does not hand that driver over today". After this PR it does. The file is not edited here.
